title: SQLite as selected NoSQLServer writable storage — v0.91 contract
summary: The complete NoSQLServer v0.91 development candidate implements explicit SQLite read/write behind the existing NoSQLServer SQL/parser/planner authority. The original native SQLite/GeoPackage reader stays read-only. The separate SQLiteWritableDatabaseEngine uses sqlite3_backup to obtain a coherent including-WAL image for the ooRexx reader and sends typed, NoSQL-approved mutations through prepared SQLite native calls.
qualified_operations: UPDATE and DELETE with whole-table schema+row guard
signed 64-bit integer and binary BLOB round trips
concurrent external WAL writer while reading
mutation_guard: For single-table predicate UPDATE/DELETE, after BEGIN IMMEDIATE compare immutable snapshot table schema and all rows (rowid plus type-exact values) with the locked live table before applying the entire prepared batch. Schema/row mismatch => rollback, including for empty selection. Change after selection cannot silently exclude a newly matching phantom.
transaction_semantics: NoSQLServer owns predicate, SQL and result semantics
SQLite owns local BEGIN IMMEDIATE/commit/rollback and prepared binding
A conflict is full rollback; never commit selected subset
If committed then snapshot refresh fails, report committed with warning, not rollback
limits: No global/multi-table serializability, cross-table JOIN predicate authority or multi-statement transaction API
A full SQLite backup file is made per SQL statement; new snapshots can consume disk and contain sensitive data
Full selected-table comparison is O(table size); unrelated table changes can trigger retry
One engine instance is not certified for simultaneous threads; native cross-process SQLite locking is local
No MI/MU shared-filesystem, distributed Storage Fabric transactional consistency or automatic remote leader authority
GeoPackage and legacy read-only engine unchanged
Crash/power-cut, disk-full, high-contention stress, native ABI portability and optional Instrumentation Mesh tests not certified

qualification.environment: Supplied ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 Ubuntu debug package + C++17 + libsqlite3
not_certified: v0.87/v0.88 Instrumentation Mesh in isolated test runtime

publication.interpretation: The merged patch intake is NOT the complete v0.91 runnable source tree.

provenance.claim: WAL-coherent backup snapshot and concurrent readers.
